section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the research design and rationale for two studies investigating the relationship between appearance goals for exercise, introjected regulation, and body image in young adult women. Study 1 is a cross-sectional study using structural equation modeling to test direct and indirect associations between these variables. Study 2 is an experimental study with a 2 × 2 design that manipulates guilt related to exercise and appearance goals orthogonally to test the proposed mediation process. The research focuses on women due to documented body image concerns in this population and differential effects of exercise on body image by gender.
